content.text:
The Friday rule was already in `src/solution.py`, so I left it as it was. On Fridays, no start time after 15:00 is returned. A 15:00 start is still allowed.

I made one change. I removed the hard-coded 12:00–13:00 lunch block, because the requirements only ask for working hours (09:00–17:00) and no conflicts with existing events. Lunch hours are now offered as slots unless an event covers them.

The function name, its signature, the 15-minute step and the overlap logic are unchanged. I didn't write or run any checks.
